apmoller.com.name: APMH Invest
apmoller.com.note: A.P. Moller Holding's direct investment arm (APMH Invest) writes large growth/buyout cheques; the venture vehicle is Maersk Growth, tracked separately (growth.maersk.com).

scanabc.com.note: Aakkoset Oy is a Finnish cybersecurity operating company (Harmonic), not an investor; mislabeled in Affinity.

accelerace.io.note: Danish accelerator that writes real pre-seed cheques via Accelerace Invest.

agvinvest.se.note: Swedish investment firm focused on proptech and real-estate decarbonisation (Harmonic).

akerasa.com.note: Industrial investment holding; startup exposure runs through Runway VC (ex-RunwayFBU, separate record) and internal ventures, not direct cheques under the Aker ASA name.

almi.se.name: Almi Invest
almi.se.note: Parent agency of Almi Invest; keep almiinvest.se as the investing record.

almiinvest.se.note: Sweden's most active state-backed seed investor.

ampli.vc.note: Stockholm evergreen (~EUR 30m), Nordic B2B SaaS, seed/Series A.

arkwrightx.vc.note: Venture arm of Arkwright; Oslo, early-stage.

askeladden.co.note: Oslo venture studio; funds its own companies at creation rather than writing external cheques.

bii.dk.name: BioInnovation Institute
bii.dk.note: Novo Nordisk Foundation-backed; deploys convertible loans and equity into life-science startups, not just grants.

businessfinland.fi.note: Grants and soft loans; its VC arm is a fund-of-funds. Direct Finnish state equity is Tesi (separate record, stays).

caddie.ventures.note: Stockholm micro-VC, B2B software (Harmonic investor record).

cbsstartup.dk.note: Copenhagen Business School student incubator; no equity cheque.

chalmersventures.com.note: University-linked but a real investor: runs funds and writes deep-tech seed cheques, unlike a TTO.

augustinusfabrikker.dk.note: Evergreen family holding (Augustinus Foundation); direct long-term investments in Danish companies. Venture-adjacent at best.

cninordic.com.name: CNI (Club Network Investments)
cninordic.com.note: Stockholm investment club / angel network writing collective cheques.

cvx.vc.note: Danish venture collective; pooled angel capital plus fund vehicles.

danskebank.com.note: Retail/commercial bank; no active venture vehicle (Danske Bank Growth is an advisory programme, not a fund).

dnb.no.note: Bank; no active CVC writing startup cheques.

e14invest.se.note: Regional Swedish co-investment company (Jamtland / E14 corridor) backing scalable growth companies.

easthillequity.com.note: Stockholm industrial-tech investor; also manages Scania Growth Capital (see scania.com record).

eifo.dk.note: Denmark's Export and Investment Fund; absorbed Vaekstfonden and VF Venture (both aliases of this record).

eqtgroup.com.note: Real PE/infrastructure firm in its own right (also houses EQT Growth); distinct from EQT Ventures, which is tracked separately.

elise-ai.eu.note: EU AI research network (ELISE), not an investor.

ventures.eviny.no.note: Venture arm of Norwegian energy group Eviny.

farvatn.com.note: Bergen family office with a venture arm (Farvatn Venture).

firda.com.note: Geir Forre's investment company (exits: Energy Micro, Chipcon, Prox Dynamics); Norwegian deep tech.

flatcapital.com.note: Listed investment company of the Siemiatkowski family (Klarna).

florent.vc.note: AI-native pre-seed/seed fund for Northern Europe; EUR 50m target debut fund (2025), Christian Dorffer/Lars Rasmussen.

founderment.dk.note: Danish venture builder; Harmonic lists it as an investor; limited public info.

founders.as.note: Copenhagen venture studio (Founders A/S); first cheques go into its own spinouts.
